name: Shrimp quesadilla
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with a pinch of salt.
Sear the shrimp and sliced bell pepper in the olive oil for two minutes until pink.
Lay the flour tortilla flat and scatter half the cheese over one side.
Spread the shrimp and pepper over the cheese, then top with the rest of the cheese and fold.
Toast the folded tortilla in the dry pan until golden on both sides and the cheese melts.
Rest for a minute, then cut into wedges.
